main_body: Large leafy tree canopy (several clumps of leaves) on a brown trunk with spreading roots
top_band: Light green leaf clumps (lime and mid green) at rows ~0-8 forming the top of the canopy; in the central column the canopy reads as stacked rounded foliage masses with light tops and darker undersides
evidence: Organic tree: canopy clumps have lighter tops and darker undersides, creating volume seen from above and the front. Trunk and roots show at the base. No receding side face and no flat elevation. Dark shadow beneath each foliage mass acts as eave shadow. The organic form does not require a hard front-edge line.

style.evidence: Candidate is drawn at the reference's scale with 5 green steps (deep, dark, mid, light, lime) in clumped leaf shapes, trunk and roots in several browns with highlights. Outlines are dark green and dark brown tinted to the neighbouring material, not black. Leaf clumps carry per-clump highlights and no large flat areas. Density matches the larger reference tree.
